war_villa.title: The Villa
war_villa.beats:
Day 363, immediately after The Dawn Raids, inside Gunga Mountain Villa: Hawks has Twice cornered in the Villa Great Hall while the raid presses inward. The Mountain Slopes still hold the student perimeter and Gigantomachia. Continue from the previous link's resolved positions; do not reset the hospital front.
The canon default course, as pressure the player can change: Hawks offers Twice surrender and tries to take him alive. Twice refuses to abandon his friends and fights to break through. Dabi intervenes; Hawks delivers the fatal strike by default. Keep Twice physically reachable through the confrontation until death is established, with room for restraint, rescue or a changed bargain. Twice's final double reaches Himiko Toga and Mr. Compress and saves them before dissolving. Its existence does not make the original Twice safe.
Dabi burns Hawks's wings and leaves him gravely injured. Fumikage Tokoyami doubles back from the perimeter, reaches Hawks, shields him with Dark Shadow and escapes with him. Let intervention change the rescue or the burns; Hawks goes to a hospital ward after stabilization, never away merely for being injured. Knowledge of his covert assignment remains confined to those who actually learn it here.
Gigantomachia wakes on the Mountain Slopes and starts toward Jaku, carrying Dabi, Himiko Toga, Spinner, Mr. Compress and Tomoyasu Chikazoku. Midnight tries to stop him with Kamui Woods and Mount Lady. Skeptic's gas and Gigantomachia's violent passage cut off her approach; she falls injured among the attackers. She sends Momo Yaoyorozu the instruction to prepare anesthetic. Her death is the canon default unless someone reaches and protects her. Keep the fall site accessible to a nearby rescuer until her fate is established; being struck down alone never proves death.
By Path: at the Villa Great Hall, League of Villains Recruits can defend, seek Twice or flee. At the Villa Grounds and Mountain Slopes, licensed Class 1-A and Class 1-B students hold routes under faculty and pros, report Midnight's last position or help Tokoyami carry Hawks. Licensed Pro Heroes, Sidekicks and Faculty can contest the giant or lead rescues. Independent Villains, Vigilantes and Civilians participate only if already on the mountain; other students gain no new deployment. Absent parties receive only reports their role can know.
The event is complete when Twice's confrontation and Hawks's extraction are resolved, Gigantomachia has begun his march or been stopped, and Midnight's fall has a recorded rescue status or established fate.
